assessment.reason: 在 2015–2026 年观察窗口内，该复合命题呈现分项实现与边界分化并存：首先，前半句“机器更擅长模仿人类意义并提升预测人类行为能力”已获直接实证支持，例如基于大语言模型与 1,000 万次人类选择微调的 Centaur 能在任意自然语言表达的实验中优于既有认知模型预测人类行为；其次，截至 2024–2025 年，ForecastBench 实证显示人类专家在真实未来事件预测上仍显著优于顶尖 LLM（p < 0.001），且 LeSC 基准显示 GPT-4 在非常见词义理解上仍落后人类 3.9%，支持人类判断在观察期内尚未被取代；但与此同时，2026 年 conlang 任务实证（arXiv:2609.34187）反驳了强“随机鹦鹉”假说、证明统计学习已能涌现“意义中介抽象”，且“原创意义”缺乏统一可测定义、终点“always（始终）”永未到期，故无法判为终局正确。

evidence_notes.quote: Here we introduce Centaur, a computational model that can predict and simulate human behavior in any experiment expressible in natural language. We derived Centaur by finetuning a state-of-the-art language model on a novel, large-scale data set called Psych-101. Psych-101 reaches an unprecedented scale, covering trial-by-trial data from over 60,000 participants performing over 10,000,000 choices in 160 experiments. Centaur not only captures the behavior of held-out participants better than existing cognitive models, but also generalizes to new cover stories, structural task modifications, and entirely new domains.
evidence_notes.limitation: 支持前半句“机器更擅长预测人类行为”，但实验场景预测能力不能直接推论机器是否具备原创意义。

evidence_notes.quote: While LLMs have achieved super-human performance on many benchmarks, they perform less well here: expert forecasters outperform the top-performing LLM ($p$-value $<0.001$).

evidence_notes.quote: Notably, even the state-of-the-art LLMs GPT-4 and GPT-3.5 lag behind 16-year-old humans by 3.9% and 22.3%, respectively. Additionally, multiple advanced prompting techniques and retrieval-augmented generation are also introduced to help alleviate this trouble, yet limitations persist.

evidence_notes.quote: Although performance varies across the spectrum of models used, these results provide evidence for meaning-mediated abstraction in LLMs and refute the strong stochastic parrot hypothesis. Our work shows that, under appropriate architectural and contextual constraints, statistical learning can produce meaning-mediated abstractions, although generation remains strongly constrained by superficial plausibility.
evidence_notes.limitation: 反驳了“LLM 仅限于表层模仿”的强随机鹦鹉论断，但同样指出生成仍受表层合理性强烈制约，未证明其具备人类主体式原创意义。
